name: MQTT Camera AI Monitor
description: Monitor MQTT channels for trigger commands, captures high-quality images from RTSP cameras using FFmpeg, and processes them through OpenAI-compatible AI endpoints for analysis. The application supports both single and multi-image capture for advanced motion detection and temporal analysis.
requires: Expects a "config.yaml" file to be mounted at the Config File path before starting the container. See configuration details: https://github.com/Cossey/mqtt-camera-ai-monitor/blob/main/config.yaml.sample

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Set the logging level for the application

variables.name: Internal Config Location
variables.description: Internal path to the configuration file. Not recommended to change.
